info.title: Growth Project API
info.description: HTTP API for The Growth Project — coach/client SaaS platform covering auth, billing, messaging, check-ins, meal plans, workouts, habits, and admin/federation surfaces. Consumed by the React Native mobile app, the coach console BFF, and partner integrations.

bearer.description: Supabase-issued JWT. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens are verified against the Supabase JWKS in JwtAuthGuard.

token.description: Google ID token from the mobile or web SDK.

invite_code.description: Optional coach invite code attached on the same call.

coach_code.description: Legacy alias of invite_code; prefer invite_code on new clients.

code.description: Invite code to preview. Format-validated server-side.

password.description: Current password — required to prevent accidental escalation.
